rationale: The approach is feasible and has a clear, actionable experiment, but carries moderate-to-high implementation risk. Proceed to experimental testing to resolve critical evidence gaps first: validate that the exogenous spike-in faithfully mimics endogenous EV capture/protection, run comprehensive capture-compatibility panels across formulation/device matrices, use a representative device-shear rig, and demonstrate reproducibility across >=3 independent conditioned-medium lots before CMC adoption.
